s: Sepeq erub mah dino ubo g' seipim: sepeq erub, kegon sapeq im haya qayyam ben hashshemashot im lav — muttar, shessepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Vehu shehinnicho sham veera bo sapeq, abal sapeq im hunnach sham im lav — asur:

Tzarik sheyyehe haerub ben hashshemashot bemaqom sherauy littelo uleoklo. Lepikak im napal alayv gal, veeno yakol littelo ad sheyyachpor bemara veqardom — eno erub, mippene shechapira zo hi melaka gemura shel tora vaasura apillu beben hashshemashot. Abal dabar shehu mishshum shebut lo gazeru alayv ben hashshemashot letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a, vehaerub gam ken hu tzorek mitzva, kede shello yetaltelu beissur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v:

Netano bemigdal venaal bepanayv, veabad hammapteach qodem shechasheka, im i epshar lehotzi mishsham haerub ella im ken yaaseh melaka gemura — hare zeh kemi sheabad, veeno erub, shehare i epshar leoklo. Veim nimtza hammapteach beshabbat, im haya bemaqom sheyyakol lahabio belo melaka shel tora — hare zeh erub. Veap al pi shello haya hammapteach beyado ben hashshemashot, kevan shemmatzuy hu sheyyimtzaennu — anu choshebim oto keshemmetzao keillu haya beyado lemaprea:
